{{Quote|This is a backward sort of world, don't you think, where the plants eat the animals?|Vestara Khai, to Olaris Rhea|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
A '''planet''' in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] was inhabited by [[Abeloth]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity who held complete control over the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Plant/Legends|flora]], which preyed upon the animals. It was notable for having numerous physical locations that corresponded to metaphysical locations in the realm known as [[beyond shadows]]. Suffering from ground tremors, It had [[Color/Legends|crimson]] [[Water/Legends|rivers]] and a rumbling [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] that contained [[Abeloth's cave]], which led to a [[Ancient ruins (Abeloth's planet)|courtyard]] with arcades surrounding the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&ndash; and [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]]-radiating [[Font of Power]].<ref name="Allies" /> The [[Pool of Knowledge]] lay near a jungle gorge and [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] at the base of the volcano. The carnivorousness of the plants, the tremors, and the volcanic rumbling of the world ceased upon Abeloth's departure.<ref name="Vortex" />

The planet was inhabited by [[The Ones/Legends|the Ones]] until the Son and Daughter imprisoned Abeloth on the world. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Abeloth sent a call out through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], taking control over the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] and forcing it to travel to the world. The [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] sent a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] under the command of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] to recover Ship and [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The strike team tracked Ship to Abeloth's planet and sent a landing party to the planet to search for the Meditation Sphere, but the world's deadly wildlife claimed the lives of many of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Eventually, the Sith found Abeloth, who agreed to protect them from the planet's dangers; although she also secretly prevented Ship from returning to the Tribe and allowed many of the Sith to die. Finally, after discovering that Skywalker and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], were at [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw, Abeloth allowed Ship to return to the Tribe to carry the few surviving Sith to the Station to [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|attack]] the Jedi. Later, in [[44 ABY]], a joint Jedi and Sith [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under the command of Luke Skywalker and Sith [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] [[Mission to the Maw|traveled]] to the world and battled with Abeloth, defeating her.
